repair_feedback: Fix two cross-lane contract violations in the bridge that prevent the dashboard from saving rule sets and applying plans. (1) `saveRuleSet` in `src/ui/services/bridge.js` L291–293 sends `body: ruleSet` but the platform endpoint `putRuleSet` requires `{ ruleSet, expectedRevision }` — wrap the draft and pass `expectedRevision` from the last saved rule set's revision. (2) `requestApply` in `src/ui/services/bridge.js` L298–303 sends `{ ops, confirmedDiffHash }` but `postApplyPlan` accepts exactly `{ confirmedDiffHash }` and rejects extra keys — remove `ops` from the body. (3) Update callers in `src/ui/pages/rulesEditorPage.js` (`handleSave` L894, `handleApply` L924) to pass the correct arguments. (4) Update bridge tests in `tests/ui/bridge.test.js` to assert the actual body shape against the endpoint contract (not just path/method). (5) Add at least one bridge→endpoint integration test that feeds a real bridge request into the real endpoint handler to catch shape mismatches end-to-end.
